verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical tall reflows with the same flaws. The orange title is left-offset while every other element is centred, and the white body copy is now bigger than the title, which inverts the hierarchy. The teal line juts toward the right edge and the contact block runs close to the bottom. A wins narrowly because it breaks the contact copy naturally ('Book your place now by phone' / number), while B splits it awkwardly at 'by / phone'. A's dashed dividers sit slightly right of centre, which is a minor flaw.
